conditional_statements.content: Great problems set for beginners! Fast I/O with cin.tie(NULL) helps on the larger tests.

Pro tip for 'Coordinates of a Point': watch out for floating point comparisons near 0. Always check strict exact coordinates first (x == 0 && y == 0) before quadrant checks to avoid wrong answer on test 3.

replies.content: Thanks a ton! Saved me from a WA, I forgot about Eixo X and Eixo Y edge checks completely.

conditional_statements.content: For Problem 8 (Sort Numbers), you don't even need arrays or std::sort if you want to practice pure branch logic! Min, max, and sum minus both gives the median in O(1) branchless logic.
